svg.text: Release orders of the modes for two operations to the same peer
A = A0 A1 A2 + signal As (submitted first), B = B0 B1 (submitted second)
one random legal order; As after A0..A2
A before B; chunks within an op reordered
A held until B released; same as reverse-ops here
As before A1, A2: breaks I1 on purpose
Colour and pattern: A units / B units / signal units (hatched). srd draws a new legal order per seed.
